info.name: SkySlope Partnership API Reference Agents, Listings API
Retrieve an up-to-date agent listings & offers count

params.name: agentId
params.description: The agent id used to filter the listings.  Contact SkySlope for your MLS field mapping.

params.name: startDate
params.description:
yyyy-mm-dd

Optional parameter in ISO format yyyy-mm-ddT00:00:00.000Z to help separating listings with new offers from the rest.

If startDate is not provided, it's assumed to be 7 days prior to today.

If there exists listings with offers newer than startDate, the hasNewOffers indicator will be true otherwise false.

items.docs: Retrieve the ten listings owned by this agent, that have most recently received offers. Sorted descending by offer submission date (most recent first).
